findings.description: Ásgeir Brinjólfsson was born about 1777, according to the 1808 church census of Hvammur parish, Dalasýsla, which lists him as a farm hand (vinnumaður) in the household of Helgi Jónsson and Guðrún Pétursdóttir alongside a maid, Sigríður Pétursdóttir; the census gives no birthplace.
supporting_sources: Iceland, Church Census, 1744-1965 — 1808 household entry for Helgi Jónsson and Guðrún Pétursdóttir, Dalasýsla, listing Ásgeir Brinjólfsson, born 1777
